'''2008 Worlds Day 2 Matt Sherrington DS My Lord, Is That Legal?''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Matt Sherrington]] at [[2008 World Championship]] (Day 2). Sheet Matt Sherrington 'CLOUDS AND STUFF' (inventory Shakir-Gold). Clouds/clones My Lord. Card count normalized to 72 from nearest same-archetype package + scan header.


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Matt Sherrington]]
* '''Event:''' [[2008 World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS16]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[My Lord, Is That Legal? / I Will Make It Legal|My Lord, Is That Legal?]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
